item.title: U.S. Southern Command Kills Two Narco-Terrorists in Eastern Pacific Strike
item.description: U.S. Southern Command confirms that on Feb. 5, Joint Task Force Southern Spear, acting under the direction of Commander Gen. Francis L. Donovan, carried out a lethal strike on a vessel operated by narco-terrorists along known narco-trafficking routes in the Eastern Pacific. Two narco-terrorists were killed in the strike. No U.S. military personnel were injured.
